description.zh: 精简人体测量模型：ln y = a + bStature*ln(S/S0) + cBmi*ln(B/B0) + sum_j factorLoadings[j]*f_j。y、S 单位毫米，B 为 kg/m2。用 ANSUR II（美国陆军，2012）拟合；说明见 tools/bodyshape/REPORT.md。
description.en: Compact anthropometric model: ln y = a + bStature*ln(S/S0) + cBmi*ln(B/B0) + sum_j factorLoadings[j]*f_j. y and S in mm, B in kg/m2. Fitted to ANSUR II (US Army, 2012); see tools/bodyshape/REPORT.md.

name.en: Relative leg length (long legs vs long trunk)

note.zh: 体型因子 f1：身高、BMI 不变时，+1 使会阴高增加约 2.5 %、坐高减少约 2 %
note.en: build factor f1: at fixed stature and BMI, +1 raises crotch height by about 2.5 % and lowers sitting height by about 2 %

name.zh: 体型分布（腰腹型–四肢/肩臂型）

note.zh: 体型因子 f2：身高、BMI 不变时，+1 使腰围增加约 4 %，四肢围度减少 1–3 %（女性：大腿下部、小腿；男性：上臂、前臂、肩）。可近似理解为同体重下“偏软”与“偏肌肉”的差别。
note.en: build factor f2: at fixed stature and BMI, +1 adds about 4 % to waist girth and takes 1-3 % off limb girths (women: lower thigh, calf; men: upper arm, forearm, shoulders). A proxy for soft vs muscular build at equal weight.

description.zh: 同一函数形式，用 NHANES 1999–2023 成人（20 岁以上、未孕）对 NHANES 有的测量项拟合。平民人群、BMI 范围完整；超出 ANSUR 的 BMI 范围时围度用这一组。部分定义与 ANSUR 不同（见各项）。
description.en: Same functional form fitted to NHANES 1999-2023 adults (20+, not pregnant) for the measures NHANES takes. Civilian, full BMI range; use these for girths outside the ANSUR BMI range. Definitions differ from ANSUR where noted.
